args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the spec (FIN-212) and `tests/test_money.py` require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `test_half_even`.

## Change
- Switch the quantize rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so ties round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`, `2.675 -> 2.68`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` passed.

transcript.content: The bug is confirmed: `round_money` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the test expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), per FIN-212. I'll create a branch and fix it.
transcript.reasoning_content:
Note test expects 2.675 -> 2.68. Banker's rounding of 2.675 to cents: 2.675 is halfway between 2.67 and 2.68; half-even picks even digit → 2.68 (8 is even). 2.665: halfway between 2.66 and 2.67; half-even picks 2.66 (6 even). So ROUND_HALF_EVEN satisfies the test. Fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

Create branch, commit, trigger CI.
